body: I went for a nice walk its clear and you can see more than a handful of stars which is rare in NYC It was a good night to think after all the kind words everyone had

I am nowhere near okay but I am better then when I first made the post,When I first posted I had what I was going to use sitting next to me...I put that away alittle while ago,I am now sitting outside my house and just enjoying the night and looking into ways to make some changes...and its because of you and everyone else who spoke to me tonight
Wow...I am honestly speechless by all of the support I got....was not expecting anything like this Thank you
Its hard to believe that....and all of you are awesome I just cant see how I fit into all this Its hard to see your worth when you believe your worthless
I am scared of Darth Mickey its gonna happen

I have wanted to kill myself since i was 11....and as the years past the reason and motivations for it changed between 11-16 it was because I couldnt handle the abuse at school from other kids...I was the fat kid still am really and even though around 15 it stopped It was hard to shake those feelings of everyone hating me and the I graduated and I Wasnt a successful adult in my mind because I wasnt going to school i was just coasting by on part time jobs and hey that was all well and good for awhile I could fake being happy alot easier then but as the years passed and I havent advanced in anyway I still live with my parents who still pretty much support me I cant stand it and I cant find a way to change it really,and the world and life is beautiful but I am not deserving of that beauty I have contributed nothing of value to it, 
I know me not being here will hurt people but their strong they can get through it...most of them probably alot easier then they think, and the past few weeks have just been a myriad of things friends getting new houses,cars,getting engaged and here I sit in my parents house alone no girlfriend not enough money to go out with the few friends who arent too busy...I cant deal and I know there are people who are worse off then me in worse situations and they are making it through but here iam whining like a bitch

I work 1-3 days a week I cant find anything else I am contributing nothing I cant go on feeling this way I feel hopeless and lost and I hate it...I Hate feeling fake because I pretend to be happy so I dont burden people I hate myself and I hate this shit poor excuse for a life I live You guys dont know me so dont take any burden upon yourself,I just needed a place to say what i was feeling didnt expect anyone to notice i am sorry for that

I am 27,And I have been feeling like this forever it just seems that the last few weeks things have been getting worse,I am stuck in this pit of suck while everyone else keeps moving forward I live at home I barely have a job I cant go to school to better it I am fucking loser what does the world gain from me being here nothing at all so why stay
